name: Product Sense & Design
title: Product sense, drilled: user empathy, structure, and sharp design trade-offs.
lede: A mock focused entirely on the product sense round — 'design a product for X', 'improve Y', 'what's your favourite product and why'. We run a realistic prompt, then I show you how to segment users, find the real pain, prioritise, and articulate trade-offs like a strong PM.
reassure: 100% money-back guarantee — if it isn't useful, tell me and I'll refund it in full.
forYou: Facing a product sense or product design round soon
Freezing on open-ended 'design a product for X' prompts
Jumping to features before nailing the user and the problem

Wanting a reusable framework, not a memorised script

deliverables: A repeatable structure for any product sense prompt

Honest feedback on where you lost the interviewer
The specific fixes to practice before the real round

faq.q: What exactly does this round test?
faq.a: Whether you can take an ambiguous prompt, zero in on a user and their real problem, and design a thoughtful solution with clear trade-offs — communicated in a structure the interviewer can follow.

faq.q: Do you give me a framework to memorise?
faq.a: I give you a structure to think with, not a script to recite. Interviewers can spot a memorised framework instantly; the goal is flexible, genuine product thinking.

faq.q: Can we do more than one prompt?
faq.a: We prioritise one realistic prompt done properly plus a thorough debrief. If time allows we'll rapid-fire a second.

finalCta.title: Walk into your product sense round ready.
finalCta.sub: Book a focused mock and leave with a structure that works under pressure.
